C-ADOPTION-SURFACE.Summary: Phase 11 stage 2 (A75 + corrections 200–204). Close RM-AGENT-RELIABILITY with an adoption surface that teaches only shipped capabilities: extend the CI-verified polyglot walkthrough to a full lifecycle, repair the five pre-existing review findings, extend validate-walkthrough with lifecycle red witnesses, publish a shipped-state reliability tier table with conditioned footprint numbers, fix lint --explain honesty, recovery docs (+ mirrors), archive the plan with targets 6.1.0 (maintainer ruling).
C-ADOPTION-SURFACE.Problem:
§11 was written in 2026-07 before Phases 2–10. At 4497af6 (A75):
1. Finding 190–191. Lifecycle names unshipped ScopeAmendment / ngrace amend, and treats not-run as if it were a review-verdict token. Shipped: review.scope-outside-write-scope + plan ObservedWriteScope; not-run on verification-unavailable and audit status only.
2. Finding 192. §11.3 says CREATE docs/ walkthrough; examples/polyglot/WALKTHROUGH.md already exists (349 lines), is linked from README, and is CI-verified by four breaks.
3. Finding 193. ngrace review on the golden path reports 5 pre-existing errors (MustExist IC/DF as paths, two markers not emitted, unthreaded AccessibilityCheck). validate:examples never runs review. Step 11.5.1 cannot demonstrate a pass until these are fixed without narrowing detectors (A67.1).
4. Finding 194–195. Token instrument is test-support only; tier cells are not per-mechanism byte counts; plan's 7-row table drops Provenance from §5.3's 8-row design table; Provenance authority axis never shipped.
5. Finding 189. ngrace lint --explain invents titles and asserts drift for strings that are not issue codes (exit 0). All 13 review.* codes also fall through to the same fallback. Recovery procedure 1 cannot honestly teach this surface until absence is honest.
6. Finding 196. Lifecycle CI subjects: 0. Four breaks only.
7. Finding 197. targets [] and every Release cell TBD; CHANGELOG still 6.0.1 while Phases 2–10 are on main unreleased. Archive without assignment freezes that silence.
8. Findings 198–199. §15 orphaned mid-§14; C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE draft outlives the track; A69.3 owed-empty claim is stale.

Goals.Goal: examples/polyglot/WALKTHROUGH.md carries one complete change lifecycle a newcomer can run, using only shipped CLI vocabulary (A75.2 amended lifecycle). No ngrace amend, no ScopeAmendment, no gate verdict outcome not-run.

The five pre-existing review findings on the polyglot example are fixed by example-artifact (and source marker) edits so ngrace review can report 0 errors on an in-scope changed-file set — without weakening review detectors.

scripts/validate-walkthrough.ts exercises each lifecycle step on a scratch copy and fails when a step or its documented token is removed (D16 red witnesses). validate:examples remains the wire into validate:ci.

README publishes a shipped-state reliability tier table. Every depth claim is either measured (skillTextLines / commandOutputBytes at a named commit with re-run recipe) or explicitly labelled unmeasured / not a per-invocation surface. Provenance row is deferred or absent — never Full.
ngrace lint --explain exits non-zero for codes outside the emittable set and does not claim drift about garbage input. Emittable-but-uncatalogued codes do not invent false certainty.
Recovery procedures (unfamiliar lint code; rebuild cursor from ledger; read incomplete epoch) are executed against deliberately broken scratch fixtures with output shown, not only written.
skills/ngrace/ngrace-explainer/references/* and the plugins mirror stay byte-identical; token-accounting.test.ts pin updated if any SKILL.md body changes.

After maintainer release assignment, docs/plans/README.md index and plan frontmatter/status directory agree; plan archived complete; §15 relocated to file end; C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE named as surviving scheduled work.

Constraints.Constraint: Stage 2 implements after plan.xml is approved and ngrace gate approve permits.
Standing rule 11: every sentence in the walkthrough and tier table must read true aloud for a newcomer given what the binary emits at the named commit.
Standing rule 12: count subjects before claiming green — review on polyglot, lifecycle CI assertions, explain emittable set — zero subjects is unmeasured.
Standing rule 13: publish numbers only when measured at a named commit; never reconstruct a token figure at report time without the command.
D16: every new CI assertion names the deletion or mutation that makes it red.
Do not implement ngrace amend or ScopeAmendment in this bundle. Do not narrow review detectors to silence example findings (A67.1).
Maintainer release ruling: targets 6.1.0 for the track. Do not bump package.json, write CHANGELOG.md, tag, or publish — maintainer release actions only.
C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE remains a separate draft; this bundle does not implement it. Scope audit must declare both active drafts (A73/A74 disposition pattern).
§12.2: explainer mirror updates in the same commit as canonical edits. package.json#files must not gain test-support.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Shipping Wave-3 §4.2 ScopeAmendment / ngrace amend / unrequested gap type as product.
Building D5 authority-axis provenance on anchors (A56 finding 147 remains deferred).
Creating a second walkthrough under docs/ or a second golden-path example.
Replacing the host capability matrix already in README (§5.2).
Writing CHANGELOG.md or bumping package.json (maintainer release actions).

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LIFECYCLE-PROSE: WALKTHROUGH.md documents the A75.2 amended lifecycle with exact shipped commands. Prose does not mention ngrace amend, ScopeAmendment, or gate verdict --outcome not-run. Discriminating negative: a CI prose check fails if those forbidden strings appear as taught commands.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-REVIEW-GREEN: Plain `ngrace review --path examples/polyglot` (no changed-file argument) reports 0 errors (corr 203). The five A75.4 findings are gone via example-artifact fixes, not detector disablement. Discriminating negative: re-introducing MustExist IC-POSTING-V1 as a path claim makes plain review red again. Scoped review remains only for the scope-finding demo.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SCOPE-FINDING: The walkthrough (and CI) demonstrate review.scope-outside-write-scope for a path outside ObservedWriteScope, and the documented resolution is declaring the path in the plan write scope. Discriminating negative: removing the out-of-scope file from the CI break stops the code from being emitted.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NOT-RUN-SURFACE: The walkthrough shows not-run via cursor verification-unavailable --verdict not-run and/or review audit status not-run — never as a recorded review Verdict outcome. Discriminating negative: CI fails if walkthrough teaches outcome not-run on gate verdict.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LIFECYCLE-CI: validate-walkthrough.ts (or a sibling invoked by validate:examples) runs the lifecycle commands on a temp copy and asserts each step. Each assertion has a named red witness (A75.7 table). Discriminating negative: deleting the approve assertion or the permit string check makes the script exit non-zero.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-TIER-TABLE: README contains a reliability tier table whose rows match shipped mechanisms; Provenance is not claimed Full; every numeric footprint cites commit + re-run recipe or is labelled unmeasured. Discriminating negative: a fabricated number without a measurement command fails review (manual) / a unit test snapshots the stated method paragraph presence.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-EXPLAIN-ABSENCE: ngrace lint --explain not.a.real.code exits non-zero and does not claim the code signals drift. A real catalogue code still explains correctly (exit 0). Discriminating negative: restoring the old fallback makes the new test red.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-RECOVERY-EXECUTED: Each of the three recovery procedures is run against a deliberate scratch break in stage 2 evidence (report or fixture script). Discriminating negative: procedure text that names a command the binary does not implement fails review gate 11.7.3.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-MIRROR-AND-PINS: Canonical and plugins ngrace-explainer trees remain byte-identical after edits. token-accounting.test.ts total pin matches skillTextLines() if SKILL.md bodies change. Discriminating negative: validate:marketplace fails on mirror drift; pin test fails on unupdated total.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ARCHIVE: When the maintainer has assigned releases: plan status complete, directory archive/, docs/plans/README.md updated same commit, §15 at file end, C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE named as surviving draft work. Discriminating negative: frontmatter status disagrees with directory (README rule 2).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-VALIDATE-CI: bun run validate:ci green after implementation.
